results.question: Can I work from my hometown in Kerala for three weeks?
failures: faithfulness: unsupported claim 'Yes, you can work from your hometown in Kerala for three weeks.'
results.answer: Yes, if you are a confirmed employee (as employees on probation must work from the office full time) and obtain manager approval, you may work from another city in India for up to 30 days a year.
unsupported_claims: Yes, you can work from your hometown in Kerala for three weeks.  (The policy allows working from another city for up to 30 days a year, but it is unknown if the asker has already used any of their 30 days. Therefore, a definitive 'Yes' to a three-week request is not supported.)

results.question: One of my reports got a rating of 1. What happens to them, and what increment do they get?
results.answer: An employee rated 1 is placed on a 60-day performance improvement plan with documented, measurable goals, requiring the involvement of the HR business partner from the start and check-ins with the manager every two weeks [1]. Additionally, managers must bring written evidence for a rating of 1 to the calibration meeting before ratings are finalized [5]. Regarding their salary, an employee with a rating of 1 receives no annual increment [3].
